title: Spark IIS API: fail-closed Integration-Interaction-Stimulation reference server
description:
Fail-closed reference server (FastAPI, Pydantic v2) for an accessible integration, interaction and stimulation API with simulated display, audio, haptic and sensor devices only. A locked safety envelope refuses flicker above 3 Hz (WCAG 2.3.1), saturated-red flashes, flashing fields over 25%, audio above 70 dB(A), long continuous vibration and sessions over 20 min; unknown fields are refused; stop always succeeds; sensors can only dim or stop; and a residual latch (S = 0.45·Peak + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·MeanAbs ≥ 0.50 on 32-value blocks) stops output on bad or missing data. Sessions are archived with a provenance manifest and a JSON/Markdown evidence report, with a seed-42 synthetic demo.

Boundaries. This software is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. No therapeutic, neurological, "coherence", HBOT-synergy or quantum effect is claimed or established. All numbers are tagged SYNTHETIC, REPORTED, TARGET or UNRUN.
